references.text: Earlier verses in the same section dealing with laws about theft and restitution for stolen animals.
Continuation of the laws on restitution, here regarding double restitution for damage to crops.
A similar principle of double restitution when a thief is caught.
Also addresses double restitution in cases of wrongful appropriation of property.
Proverbs refers to sevenfold restitution for theft, which builds on the principle of restitution from the Mosaic Law.
Parallel laws concerning the return of stolen goods with an added fifth.
Law requiring full restitution plus a fifth for sin against another person.
Complementary rules on graduated restitution: double when found alive (22:3) versus fourfold or fivefold in cases of slaughter or sale (21:37).
